tasks.title: LVM board: snapshots and thin pools
tasks.statement: Snapshots for backups and thin pools under write load. A scenario has a workload: how many gibibytes change during the backup window and how many are written to the thin volumes. A classic snapshot overflows when more has changed than it can hold, and then the copy is lost; a thin pool fills up with data and with metadata. Five scenarios: snapshot size, heavy writes, an overprovisioned pool, pool metadata, and a snapshot of a thin volume. The exercise is solved when all scenarios are solved.
tasks.hint: A snapshot never needs more room than the volume itself. For a thin pool watch both Data% and Meta%: the metadata can run out before the data. Autoextend helps only while the volume group has free space.
